description.value:
“You are not an animal that learned to talk. You are a story the world made into a person because it needed you in the room.”

Folklore Presence. Once per a Soma Break, when you first meet a community, you may decide whether the rumors about you arrived first. If yes, gain reroll the lowest die on your first Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) (Presence) (Presence) checks [TODO(adv-call)] with anyone in that community (your choice which skill, declared when you roll). The rumor is not always flattering — the GM gets to colour it.

Wasteland Adapted. You have reroll the lowest die on defense checks [TODO(adv-call)] against disease and environmental poison. You can subsist on rations that would sicken most humans (spoiled meat, swamp water, mushroom flesh).

Survivor’s Instinct. When you would drop to 0 Integrity, you may instead drop to 1 Integrity and gain one level of Stress. Once per a Soma Break.
